description: Golden reference for metatrain PET model 'pet-mad-xs', case 'molecule'. Energy in eV, positions in Angstrom, forces in eV/Angstrom. Total energy INCLUDES composition energies and the output scaler (energy_scale).
evaluation_path: metatrain.utils.io.load_model(ckpt).export() -> metatomic AtomisticModel; metatomic ASE MetatomicCalculator.compute_energy(atoms, compute_forces_and_stresses=True, per_atom=True)
notes: total_energy = energy_scale * sum_i(E_backbone_i) + sum_i(composition_energy[Z_i]). forces = energy_scale * F_backbone (composition energies are constant per type and do not contribute to forces). See the converted model JSON for energy_scale and composition_energies.
